tasks.CalculateTotalCharsList1: Calculates the total number of characters in all strings within lst1.
tasks.CalculateTotalCharsList2: Calculates the total number of characters in all strings within lst2.
tasks.CompareCharCounts: Compares the total character counts between lst1 and lst2 to determine which list has fewer characters or if they are equal.
tasks.ReturnResult: Returns the appropriate result based on the comparison.
